items.text: Police chief in Christa Pike's arrest has message about victim after botched execution
items.article: Christa Pike's botched lethal injection may end capital punishment in Tennessee, says former Knoxville police chief who oversaw her arrest in Colleen Slemmer's 1995 murder. Phil Keith was Knoxville's chief of police in the 1990s, when Christa Pike and two friends tortured and killed a classmate named Colleen Slemmer. Tennessee's failed attempt to lethally inject 30-year death row inmate Christa Pike Wednesday evening has not only put her execution in jeopardy, it may lead to the state taking capital punishment off the table altogether, according to the former Knoxville police chief who oversaw her arrest in the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in 1995. "I'll be surprised if there are any executions in Tennessee in the near term, if again, ever," Phil Keith, who led Knoxville's police department from 1988 until 2004, told Fox News Digital. Pike attracted national attention in the days before her scheduled execution on Sept. 30 with a last-minute appeal, a petition for clemency and requests for alternate modes of capital punishment and a team of all-female executioners. Then the botched attempts to lethally inject her became the dominant story. items.text: Tesla’s recovery hits a speed bump
items.article: The company’s sales dipped in the third quarter, after customers raced to cash in on expiring tax credits last year. Tesla sold fewer vehicles in the third quarter than it did a year ago, when consumers rushed to cash in on expiring federal tax credits for electric vehicle purchases. But the company still beat estimates from Wall Street, suggesting that it’s recovery was still on track. Tesla said that it produced a total of 464,391 vehicles between July and September of this year, including 457,387 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles, as well as 7,004 “other vehicles” like the Cybertruck, Cybercab, and Tesla Semi. (The company discontinued the Model S and X earlier this year.) That represents about a 3.8 percent increase compared to the third quarter of 2025, when the company produced 447,450 vehicles. Tesla also said that it delivered to customers a total of 486,532 vehicles, including 481,166 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles, as well as 8,295 other vehicles — about a 2.1 percent decrease compared to the blockbuster third quarter of 2025, when it delivered 497,099 vehicles. (For a direct-to-consumer company like Tesla, deliveries are a proxy for sales.) The drop in sales was widely expected thanks to the expiration of the $7,500 federal tax credit for electric vehicles on September 30, 2025. Elon Musk himself said that the company was in for “a few rough quarters” thanks to the expiring incentive and other macroeconomic factors. But Musk also said he believes that Tesla will rebound

items.text: The Pocket Advance nearly perfects my favorite Nintendo handheld
items.article: Ayaneo’s Konkr Pocket Advance resurrects and upgrades the Game Boy Advance with a larger screen, extra buttons, and more capabilities. It’s a faithful Game Boy Advance clone, but the Pocket Advance runs Android, so you can play more than just GBA games. Although I count the original Game Boy as one of my first tech obsessions, I still consider Nintendo’s Game Boy Advance to be my favorite console of all time thanks to its more comfortable horizontal design (for my big hands) and its expansive catalog of excellent 32-bit and 16-bit games. Ayaneo isn’t the first company to attempt to modernize the GBA, but its Konkr Pocket Advance does it best. The handheld strikes a near perfect balance between authentically re-creating the GBA’s design while updating its hardware with new controls, a much better screen, and the flexibility of Android at a price that feels like a bargain. As much as I still adore the GBA, I’ve eagerly embraced upgrades to the aging console over the years. First it was the clamshell GBA SP that finally delivered a frontlit screen I could actually see without a lamp over my shoulder, and later it was aftermarket upgrades like a backlit LCD display and a rechargeable battery that vastly improved Nintendo’s original hardware. Two years ago, I eagerly purchased Anbernic’s GBA-inspired RG34XX , but all of those have now been replaced by the Konkr Pocket Advance. items.article: Daily Mail's Wiliam Hunter travelled to the Tabernas Desert to see how ESA and Airbus are getting ready for what could be the most important mission in space exploration history. By WILIAM HUNTER, SENIOR SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY REPORTER Published: 13:45, 2 October 2026 | Updated: 13:45, 2 October 2026 It's one of the biggest unanswered questions in astronomy: has life ever existed on Mars – and could it still be there today? We may finally find out in just two years, when the European Space Agency's (ESA) Rosalind Franklin rover makes the 140 million–mile journey to the Red Planet. However, before the £1 billion rover can make that epic journey, scientists need to test that everything is working exactly as it should. That is why I travelled out to the Tabernas Desert in Southeast Andalusia to see how ESA and Airbus are getting ready for what's tipped to be the most important mission in space exploration history.

items.text: Can Miami really be the new New York?
items.article: Only if it dumps its developer-run government and focuses on putting wealth to good use. The MacArthur Causeway, three and a half miles of road between downtown Miami and South Beach, is flanked by two examples of the region’s struggles to build. At the western end sits the I-395 Signature Bridge, six concrete arches that were meant to “redefine the Miami skyline.” The state awarded the contract to build in 2017; the project is now expected to be completed sometime in 2029. Over this period, the price has climbed from $802 million to $866 million. The contractor is suing its own designer and insurer for $400 million. A worker died on the job in March, two months after six others were hospitalized. Only four of the six arches are standing.

items.key: ai:5 sarees from west bengal to add to your durga puja wardrobe
items.text: 5 sarees from West Bengal to add to your Durga Puja wardrobe
items.article: Besides being a festival of faiths, feasts and festivities, Durga Puja is also an exhibition of Bengali culture and craft. Dressing up in Bengali sarees cannot be replaced by anything else for this very reason! Be it the comfort of Tant or the luxury of Baluchari, Bengali traditional wear encapsulates Bengali ethos perfectly. So if you are going to celebrate Saptami, Ashtami, Navami or Dashami this year, take a close look at 5 traditional Bengali sarees from Bengal that you would not want to miss! If there's one saree that instantly transports you to a Bengali celebration, it's the Tant saree. Traditionally handmade from cotton, this saree is perfect for those blistering hot Puja days. The ever-so-classic white and red border tant saree is a must-have in any Bengali woman's festive wardrobe, especially during Durga puja. But, nowadays, tant sarees come in all shades of the rainbow! Garad saree is a traditional drape worn by Bengalis during festivals. This traditional Bengali piece features a simple white or off-white saree with red borders and pallu, which has been worn during religious festivals and Bengali rituals. The simplicity of the Garad saree is what sets it apart. The subtle shades of the body of the saree enable the red borders to take centre stage, making it elegant, traditional, and distinct.
